summary: Notification channels become an open registry (notifications.ChannelRegistry, ChannelSpec, ContributeChannel; Channel.Valid is a format check and the channel CHECK of core.notification_deliveries and core.notification_channel_preferences becomes ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$), with opt-in channels, per-tenant channel connections (core.notification_channel_connections, picked on /settings/notifications) and user channel links through one-use deep link tokens (ChannelLinkService, core.notification_channel_links). The Telegram channel (modules/core/notifications/telegramchannel) sends to the private chat a user linked with /start u_<token> and is contributed by the automations module whenever its directory has the Telegram connector (on by default; automations.WithoutTelegram leaves both out); the profile gets a «Notifications» section with channel switches, Telegram linking and a test notification. NotificationChannelService.Available and Validate and NotificationRoutingService.Channels now take a context (the tenant's channels); a delivery on a channel the tenant lost is skipped with channel_not_configured.
